pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of secondary entries within 3 pips/dollars of an existing active position; sequential scaling only permitted after a 1R locked-in profit threshold.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order execution unless the current 1-minute Average True Range (ATR) expansion ratio is below 1.5 and order book imbalance exceeds 65% directional bias.
profit_harvest_threshold: Instantly initiate trailing stops or partial profit closure when floating profit hits +$15.00 to guarantee asymmetric outcomes ($15-$30+).
